subject: Fat's hidden clock: how ageing adipose tissue drives metabolic decline
script: From Agewell Brief: Fat's hidden clock: how ageing adipose tissue drives metabolic decline. A new review maps the cellular remodelling of fat tissue with age, linking senescent cells and immune shifts to disease risk, and weighs interventions from caloric restriction to senolytics. Ageing remodels fat tissue: adipocyte hypertrophy, progenitor exhaustion, immune infiltration. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
